_comment: The source of truth for the app's text (#87). Keys are stable dotted names, never the English text; placeholders are {named}; plural entries are objects keyed by CLDR category. Plain text only: no HTML, no entities. See docs/UI_ARCHITECTURE.md, "Languages".
settings.language.label: Language
settings.language.help: System default follows the Windows display language when the monitor offers it, else English. Apply reloads the dashboard.
_note.settings.update.progress.label: Settings, System card, while an update runs: the name a screen reader gives the progress bar.
settings.update.progress.label: Update download
_note.settings.update.progress.step.down: Settings, System card, while an update runs: the first of the update's three steps, a chip that shows whether the step is done, under way or still to come. Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals. Short: the three chips sit on one line.
_note.settings.update.progress.step.chec: Settings, System card, while an update runs: the second step: the downloaded installer is checked against the release's SHA-256. Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals. Short, as the other two.
_note.settings.update.progress.step.rest: Settings, System card, while an update runs: the third step: the installer starts and the monitor closes and starts again. Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals. Short, as the other two.
_note.settings.update.progress.size: Settings, System card, while an update runs: under the progress bar, and what a screen reader says of the bar. {done} and {total} are megabytes with one decimal, in the language's own numbers. MB is the unit: write megabytes as the language abbreviates them (French: Mo).
_note.settings.update.progress.size_unkn: Settings, System card, while an update runs: under the progress bar when the server did not say how large the installer is. {done} is megabytes with one decimal, in the language's own numbers. MB is the unit: write megabytes as the language abbreviates them (French: Mo).
_note.settings.update.progress.connectin: Settings, System card, while an update runs: under the progress bar before the first bytes arrive. GitHub is a name.
_note.settings.update.progress.downloadi: Settings, System card, while an update runs: the status line under the progress bar while the installer downloads. Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals. {version} is the version number, as written (2.4.0).

Settings, System card, while an update runs: the status line under the progress bar while the installer downloads and its size is not known. Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals. {version} is the version number, as written.
settings.update.progress.downloading_unk: Downloading version {version}; the server did not say how large it is.
_note.settings.update.progress.checking: Settings, System card, while an update runs: the status line under the progress bar while the installer is compared with the SHA-256 the release lists. Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals. SHA-256 is a name.
settings.update.progress.checking: Checking the download against the release's SHA-256.
_note.settings.update.progress.starting: Settings, System card, while an update runs: the status line under the progress bar while the installer is started. Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals.
_note.settings.update.progress.restartin: Settings, System card, while an update runs: the status line under the progress bar once the installer is running and the monitor is closing for it. Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals. {version} is the version number, as written.
settings.update.progress.restarting: The monitor closes to install version {version} and starts again by itself.
_note.settings.update.progress.stalled: Settings, System card, while an update runs: the status line under the progress bar when nothing has arrived for 15 seconds. The download goes on if data comes again, and stops after a minute with nothing. Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals.
settings.update.progress.stalled: The download has stalled; it carries on if data starts to arrive again.
_note.settings.update.progress.lost: Settings, System card, while an update runs: the status line under the progress bar when the dashboard stops hearing from the monitor while the update downloads or is checked. Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals.
settings.update.progress.lost: The dashboard lost its link to the monitor during the update.
_note.settings.update.progress.gone: Settings, System card, while an update runs: the status line under the progress bar when the dashboard stops hearing from the monitor once it has started closing for the installer. It names no version: if the installer cannot run, the version already installed starts again. Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals. The tray icon is the monitor's icon in the Windows notification area.
settings.update.progress.gone: The monitor is closing to install the update. Open the dashboard again from the tray icon once it is back.
_note.settings.update.progress.failed.ti: Settings, System card: the status line after an update stopped, shown until the next click on an update button. Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals. {seconds} is a number of seconds, in the language's own numbers.
settings.update.progress.failed.timeout: The download stopped: nothing arrived for {seconds} seconds.
_note.settings.update.progress.failed.ne: Settings, System card: the status line after an update stopped, shown until the next click on an update button. The connection itself failed (no network, a name that could not be looked up, a secure connection that could not be made). Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals.
settings.update.progress.failed.network: The download stopped: the connection to GitHub failed.
_note.settings.update.progress.failed.ht: Settings, System card: the status line after an update stopped, shown until the next click on an update button. Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals. {status} is an HTTP status number such as 404, as written.
settings.update.progress.failed.http: The download stopped: GitHub answered HTTP {status}.
_note.settings.update.progress.failed.re: Settings, System card: the status line after an update stopped, shown until the next click on an update button. The download was sent on to an address that is not HTTPS (a plain-http address, a file: or data: link, or any other kind), and the monitor follows secure (HTTPS) addresses only. Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals.
settings.update.progress.failed.redirect: The download stopped: it was redirected to an address that is not HTTPS, which the monitor does not follow.
_note.settings.update.progress.failed.to: Settings, System card: the status line after an update stopped, shown until the next click on an update button. Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals. {limit} is megabytes, in the language's own numbers. MB is the unit: write megabytes as the language abbreviates them (French: Mo).
settings.update.progress.failed.too_larg: The download stopped: the installer is larger than {limit} MB.
_note.settings.update.progress.failed.cu: Settings, System card: the status line after an update stopped, shown until the next click on an update button. The server ended the download before the size it announced. Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals.
settings.update.progress.failed.cut_shor: The download stopped before the whole installer arrived.
_note.settings.update.progress.failed.di: Settings, System card: the status line after an update stopped, shown until the next click on an update button. Nothing was run. Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals. SHA-256 is a name.
settings.update.progress.failed.digest: The download did not match the release's SHA-256 and was deleted; the release page was opened in your browser.
_note.settings.update.progress.failed.re: Settings, System card: the status line after an update stopped, shown until the next click on an update button. Nothing was downloaded or run. Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals.
settings.update.progress.failed.rejected: The installer link is not this project's release download; the release page was opened in your browser.
_note.settings.update.progress.failed.he: Settings, System card: the status line after an update stopped, shown until the next click on an update button. The download checked out, but the small program that runs the installer once the monitor has closed did not start. Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals.
settings.update.progress.failed.helper: The installer could not be started.
_note.settings.update.progress.failed.lo: Settings, System card: the status line after an update stopped, shown until the next click on an update button. A file on this PC, not the connection: a full disk, a file held by a security scanner, a temporary folder that could not be made. Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals.
settings.update.progress.failed.local: The update stopped: a file it needs could not be written or moved on this PC.
_note.settings.update.progress.failed.er: Settings, System card: the status line after an update stopped, shown until the next click on an update button. Any other reason. Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals.
settings.update.progress.failed.error: The update could not be installed.

_note.widget.nostromo.state.normal: Nostromo's widget header, the word on the right while every limit is in its normal range. In capitals, as all of Nostromo's words.
_note.widget.nostromo.state.warning: Nostromo's widget header, the word on the right while a limit is at its warning level. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.state.critical: Nostromo's widget header, in a filled chip on the right while a limit is critical. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.state.stale: Nostromo's widget header, the word on the right while the numbers shown are the last ones read (the sign-in needs the user). In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.state.offline: Nostromo's widget header, the word on the right while there is no connection to the usage API. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.state.paused: Nostromo's widget header, the word on the right while updates are paused. Not the usage guard's hold (widget.nostromo.guard.hold). In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.state.loading: Nostromo's widget header, the word on the right while the first reading is awaited. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.state.rate_limited: Nostromo's widget header, the word on the right while the usage API is throttling the monitor (it retries by itself). In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.state.no_credentia: Nostromo's widget header, the word on the right while there is no sign-in. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.guard.hold: Nostromo's widget header, the chip on the right while the usage guard holds and no resume time is known. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.guard.hold_for: Nostromo's widget header, the chip on the right while the usage guard holds. {countdown} is the time left until work can resume, as the app writes it (2H 14M). In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.guard.mark: Nostromo's widget header, a quiet mark while the usage guard is armed, drawn only where it fits. Keep the brackets. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.guard.mark_short: The short form of widget.nostromo.guard.mark, for a header with no room for it. Keep the brackets. In capitals.

_note.widget.nostromo.guard.armed_list: Nostromo's hover card, the lead of the guard line while the guard is armed, before the caps it watches (GUARD ARMED: SESSION 95%, WEEKLY 90%). The colon is the language's; the lead is kept on one line. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.guard.holding: Nostromo's hover card, the guard line while the guard holds with nothing to list: the lead alone. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.guard.holding_list: Nostromo's hover card, the lead of the guard line while the guard holds, before the limits at their caps and the resume time. The colon is the language's; the lead is kept on one line. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.guard.limit: Nostromo's hover card, a limit in the guard line: {name} is its name, as the rows name it; {percent} is its cap while the guard is armed, its reading while it holds (SESSION 96%). Kept on one line. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.guard.cap: Nostromo's hover card, after a limit's reading in the guard line while the guard holds: the cap it reached (WEEKLY 91% (CAP 90%)). {percent} is written as a percent. Kept on one line. In capitals.

_note.widget.nostromo.guard.time_left: Nostromo's hover card, the time left in the guard line: {countdown} as the app writes it (2H 14M). Kept on one line. In capitals.

_note.widget.nostromo.resets.unknown: Nostromo's hover card, under a row whose reset time is not known yet. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.pace.none: Nostromo's hover card, right of the reset: no pace to tell (no reading or no reset time yet). In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.pace.on: Nostromo's hover card, right of the reset: usage keeps pace with the time gone in the window (within 10 points). In capitals.

_note.widget.nostromo.pace.behind: Nostromo's hover card, right of the reset: usage is behind the time gone in the window. {points} is by how many percentage points, signed (-18). In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.pace.points: Nostromo's hover card, right of the reset: the short form of widget.nostromo.pace.ahead and .behind, for a line too tight for them (a long reset time). {points} is the signed percentage points (+21, -18); the tone says ahead or behind. English never shows it. In capitals.
